newsitem.title: UK: Russia PGM exports to begin May/June - Almaz offical.
newsitem.headline: Russia PGM exports to begin May/June - Almaz offical.

text.p: Russia will begin its 1997 platinum group metals (PGMS) export campaign at the end of this month or at the beginning of June, a senior Rusisan export agency official said Tuesday.
Boris Ossipov, president Almaz USA Inc, told Reuters the necessary export decreee had been signed by President Boris Yeltsin and individual licences had been issued.
Russia supplies about 66 percent of the world's palladium. It is the second largest exporter of platinum after South Africa.
Whether exports occurred this month or next depended on whether individual export licences were for five or seven days, he said.

Asked if the export campaign would include shipments to Japan, Russsia's major customer and the worlds's largest consumer of PGMs, Ossipov said, "Exports will be worldwide. They will be to Europe, the U.S. Japan is not a special place for us," and did not elaborate.

He said the material was there to meet demand. "Export levels will be adjusted to meet the needs of the market," he said and prices will be market based, geared to the after London platinum and palladium fixings. avaiability of 6.82 million ounces.
